[[Dinosaur]]s roam the northern zone, while [[Simian]]s and [[Quetzal]] [[Tengu]] are found in the southern reaches. ==Getting there== Leave via any of the exits in the [[Tarnished Haven]]. If that outpost has not been reached, then start from [[Rata Sum]] and pass through either [[Magus Stones]] or [[Riven Earth]]. ==Shrines== ;[[Resurrection shrine]]s with [[bounty|bounties]]: You can shut up now."'' :'''Oggy''': ''"Yes, Ma'am."'' ==Landmarks== * Mysterious Stone Heads ==Notes== *[[Interactive object]]s **[[Taro Plant]] *These quests affect the [[spawn]]s in this area: **[[A Little Help]] **[[The Cipher of Melandru]] **[[The Justiciar's End]] **[[Norn Catering]] **[[Turning the Page]] *{{Vanquisher|count = 229|low = 220|high = 237}} **When engaging dinosaurs in [[Hard mode]] (excluding Raptors), forgetting to spread out in their [[area of effect]] damage will easily kill bunched up heroes and henchmen. Ceratadons particularly must be avoided at melee range due to their deadly spells. **[[Shing Jea Sherman]] can be used as an additional ally for foes to [[target]], which can relieve some pressure off your party. ** When looking for your final foes, remember there is a group of Simians right up against the portal to [[Arbor Bay]]. *This area can be completely explored without enemies during the quest [[Insidious Remnants]] for [[Master of the North]]. {{anomaly|The southern edge of the map does not line up with the character perspectives along the coast. For this reason, some of the explorable footage in those areas does not clear when explored.}} ==Trivia== * The bridge in the northwest corner of Alcazia, next to Magus Stones portal, and the one in the northeast corner, near Arbor Bay, each contain a white (untextured) male warrior model in [[Warrior_Luxon_armor|Luxon armor]]. These may be graphics relics, similar to "[[The Naked Man]]" models that used to be in Gunnar's Hold and Bukdek Byway. {{Explorable areas in the Tarnished Coast}} [[de:Alcazia-Dickicht]]
